# The CodeMap graph tools

Both servers are read-only stdio MCP servers over the pack; start them with `CODEMAP_PACK_DIR` set to the pack directory and an absolute script path (Claude Code does not honour a working directory in an MCP config).

## engine (`applications/CodeMap/remote/engine_mcp.py`)

- **`engine_step`**(dsl) — One CMDSL verb against the code graph: map() / enter(sub) / find(term) / impact(entity[,depth]) / flow(entity[,depth]) / seam(subA,subB) / cohort(entity) / spine(sub) / health(kind) / read(entity). Entity names and sub ids must be copied exactly from a previous result or the question.
- **`engine_cypher`**(stmt) — One read-only openCypher statement over the pack (nodes :Entity {name, entity_type, layer, curated, local_height, entry_point, line_count}; edges (:Entity)-[r:Dep {rel}]->(:Entity)). Always LIMIT; prefer count(*) / ORDER BY over listing. No CASE inside count()/sum() (dialect bug).
- **`engine_open`**(name) — Exact entity name -> pointer (repo, relative path, subsystem, lines). Never file content.

## pack (`applications/CodeMap/graph/delta/pack_mcp.py`)

- **`pack_subsystem`**(id) — The L2 navigator record of a subsystem id (name, role, summary, responsibilities, entry points, size, parent).
- **`pack_entity`**(name) — An entity row (by exact name) with its edges in both directions and the neighbours' subsystems.
- **`pack_folder`**(fragment, limit) — Entities whose path contains the given fragment, with the subsystem mix of that folder.
- **`pack_cypher`**(stmt) — One read-only openCypher statement over the pack (Entity, Dep{rel}); LIMIT enforced.

## Verbs for `engine_step`

| verb | arguments |
|---|---|
| `map` | none |
| `enter` | one |
| `find` | one |
| `impact` | 1 or 2 |
| `flow` | 1 or 2 |
| `seam` | two |
| `cohort` | one |
| `spine` | one |
| `health` | one |
| `read` | one |

`health` takes `coupling` (subsystems by external ratio) or `hubs` (entities by in-degree). `answer`, `pass` and `cache` belong to the served navigator's loop and are not for agents.
